purpose: Convert the V40 transferable supervised structure-location and object-amplitude information into a minimally invasive stochastic residual field while retaining the frozen V31 donor identities, isometries, conditional-rank multiset, conditional inverse, and exact residual-DC projection.

inherited_inputs.selection_rule: reuse every frozen V28/V31 query, donor identity, donor isometry, and 16-by-16 member pairing byte-for-byte

train_only_supervised_fit.structure_target: the exact V40 extreme label: a factor-4 block is positive when it contains a native voxel above its source train-only q99.99 log10-density threshold

structure_features.full: the exact V40 222-component factor-4 oriented multiscale descriptor

train_only_supervised_fit.structure_rows: the exact V40 extreme positive/negative priority reservoirs and source-balanced common row count
train_only_supervised_fit.structure_learner: the exact frozen V40 HistGradientBoostingClassifier specification
train_only_supervised_fit.object_target: log10 cube mean delta squared with delta=10**(4.5*y)-1
train_only_supervised_fit.object_features: the exact V40 28 target-free factor-4 object summaries
train_only_supervised_fit.object_rows: all train objects with equal total sample weight per TNG100, SIMBA, and Swift source
train_only_supervised_fit.object_learner: the exact frozen V40 HistGradientBoostingRegressor specification
train_only_supervised_fit.seed_block_count: round to nearest integer the equal-source mean number of extreme-positive factor-4 train blocks per cube; fit once and store

minimal_structure_seeding.block_grid: 16^3 blocks of 4^3 native voxels at 1.25 Mpc/h
minimal_structure_seeding.query_risk: full train-only classifier probability on the actual query target-free descriptor
minimal_structure_seeding.donor_carrier_score: maximum frozen V31 conditional-rank value in each complete donor block after its frozen isometry
minimal_structure_seeding.target_blocks: the fixed seed_block_count highest-risk query blocks with deterministic flat-index tie breaking
minimal_structure_seeding.carrier_blocks: the same count of highest-score donor blocks with deterministic flat-index tie breaking
minimal_structure_seeding.carrier_assignment: one-to-one Hungarian assignment with periodic block-distance cost plus squared normalized target-rank/carrier-rank mismatch cost
minimal_structure_seeding.completion: assign unused donors to unused query blocks by identity wherever possible, then Hungarian periodic-distance matching between the remaining displaced query and donor indices
minimal_structure_seeding.transport: copy complete 4^3 conditional-rank blocks under the resulting exact permutation; all other blocks remain identity mapped
invariants: exact preservation of every donor conditional-rank value
at most twice seed_block_count nonidentity blocks

object_amplitude_calibration.prediction: the train-only full object regressor prediction for log10 mean delta squared
object_amplitude_calibration.uncalibrated_residual: V31 conditional inverse of the seeded conditional-rank field at the actual query backbone, followed by exact residual-mean subtraction
object_amplitude_calibration.scale_family: query backbone plus s times the uncalibrated residual with s in [0,2]
object_amplitude_calibration.fixed_solver: evaluate the generated log10 mean delta squared at s=0,1,2; linearly interpolate s in the bracketing log-amplitude segment, choose the nearest boundary if the prediction is outside both segments, then evaluate once at the selected s
diagnostics: predicted and achieved log10 mean delta squared

matched_arms.two_stage: actual full structure-risk map and actual full object-amplitude prediction
matched_arms.backbone_risk_ablation: backbone-only structure-risk map and unchanged actual full object-amplitude prediction
matched_arms.rolled_risk_control: actual full risk map periodically rolled by the fixed factor-4 offset (3,5,7) and unchanged actual full object-amplitude prediction
matched_arms.shuffled_amplitude_control: actual full structure-risk map and the next frozen query object's amplitude prediction cyclically within the same domain
matched_arms.common: all four arms reuse identical query, donor identity, donor isometry, conditional-rank cube, seed count, conditional inverse, scale solver, and output evaluation

development_evaluation.primary_pass: two_stage passes the complete field, Q3, and Q4 gates independently in all three domains
development_evaluation.selection_role: only two_stage can be selected; controls are causal diagnostics and cannot rescue it

fixed_branches.condition: Q3 and Q4 pass every domain but any field check fails
Q4 passes every domain but Q3 fails anywhere
Q3 passes every domain but Q4 fails anywhere

hard_preflight: full pytest and clean committed worktree
exact V40 parent audit, V35 data/cache, V31 copula, selection, and reference hashes
fit report proves train-only source-balanced structure and object models with validation unopened
synthetic and real seed permutations are complete bijections and preserve the conditional-rank multiset exactly
all four real-arm samples are finite with residual DC below 1e-7 and amplitude scale inside [0,2]
all arms use identical frozen donor selections and no validation truth for risk or amplitude prediction
Astrid and historical EAGLE remain unopened
